Committed. Here's what happened:

**Heads-up first:** before committing I found the doc had been moved out of the repo root into `docs/jolli-memory/` (and the stray `graph/` export folder was gone). I didn't make that move — but since the doc now sits *inside* the images folder, its image links (`docs/jolli-memory/how-it-works.svg`) would have resolved to `docs/jolli-memory/docs/jolli-memory/…` and broken. So I rewrote all four links to bare filenames (`how-it-works.svg`, etc.) relative to the doc's new location, and verified no stale paths remain.

**Branch + commit:**
- Branched off `main` → **`docs/jolli-memory-guide`**
- Commit **`39cd827`** — "Add Jolli Memory viewing guide with diagrams and screenshots"
- Five files, exactly what you asked (nothing stray):
  - `docs/jolli-memory/README-JOLLI-MEMORY.md`
  - `docs/jolli-memory/how-it-works.svg`
  - `docs/jolli-memory/knowledge-graph-overview.png`
  - `docs/jolli-memory/knowledge-graph-topics.png`
  - `docs/jolli-memory/knowledge-wiki.png`

Working tree is clean. Note: the Jolli post-commit hook likely kicked off an async summary for this commit — normal for this repo.
